schema.title: The Virtual Cinematographer
schema.description: A film idiom: a finite state machine in which each state invokes a particular camera module.

CameraPlacement.description: Directors specify camera placements relative to the line of interest. Common camera placements include external, internal, and apex views.

CameraModule.description: The example camera modules of section 3.2.1 (sixteen were implemented).

IdiomState.description: Each state invokes a particular camera module; each state corresponds to a separate shot.

actors.description: The actors the camera module takes as input, the primary actors.

name.description: The idiom: a stereotypical way to capture a particular type of scene.

subIdioms.description: Idioms are organized hierarchically: an idiom may call more specific idioms and return control to a more general one.
